title: Slots Without Clues
flavor_text: Only the extraction card survived the flood.
content: Seven answer slots have requested indices 1, 2, 1, 3, 2, 4, 1. Candidate fills must produce, in order, letters L, A, N, T, E, R, N. Work backward to state what constraints the missing mini-puzzles must satisfy before accepting the extraction.
